free_text_notes.physician_note: 88-year-old woman with hypertension, osteoporosis, admitted 3/29 with AECOPD with hypercapnic respiratory failure, now resolved. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation. Needs pulmonology clinic follow-up within 14 days of discharge. Oxygen saturation briefly dipped to 93 percent during a period of exertion on day 2. The patient was rested and saturation returned to 97 percent. No change to the oxygen plan was needed.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with sister.
